name: Four Seasons Naples Beach Club
positioning: Newly built beachfront resort in Old Naples on Florida's Gulf Coast
best_for: Travelers who want a Gulf Coast beach resort in Old Naples
Guests who want tennis, a large spa and several dining venues on site

facts.text: The resort has 220 rooms in total.
The resort sits on 1,000 feet of white-sand beach.
The resort is in the heart of Old Naples.
The resort is approximately 5 miles from Naples Airport.
The Merchant Room is the signature restaurant, offering new American cuisine from Chef Gavin Kaysen.
HB's is a seafood-forward restaurant with beachfront dining.
Sunset Bar holds a ceremonial blowing of the conch each night at sunset.
The resort has 6 Har-Tru tennis courts.

highlights.text: The spa is a 30,000 square-foot wellness destination set across three levels.
The spa has a thermal circuit with steam rooms, a Finnish sauna and an ice lounge.
The fitness centre was designed by celebrity trainer Harley Pasternak and has 24/7 access.
The resort offers a supervised kids' program called FIN's Club, year round.

considerations.text: The resort is approximately 32 miles from Southwest Florida International Airport.
Tennis lessons are for a fee.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflects the upscale market positioning.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
